label: first-token identity (12 tokens) at t=0, OR late copy-phase inputs j/f/n
explanation: Two disjoint components. (1) Step 0 (62% of activation mass): fires deterministically whenever the first original token is one of a,b,c,e,f,g,j,n,p,r,s,3 (precision 1.0 and full recall at t=0). Magnitude depends only on the token: f (~0.45 of max) and j (~0.47) are highest, n ~0.32, r ~0.24, 3 ~0.20, g ~0.17, a/b/p weakest (~0.03-0.08). (2) Copy phase, late (recall_idx >= 3, about 38% of mass): fires when the fed-back input is j, f or n, and more weakly on e, r, c, z, v. The largest activations in the whole dataset (near max) are here, on copy-phase f/j inputs. It is essentially silent during original steps 1..L-1, at the delimiter, and in the first three copy steps. The copy clause is noisy: many late j/f/n copy inputs do not fire (precision about 0.4 for that clause alone), and some e/c/z inputs fire without being covered.
